skill.name: create-svg-from-prompt
skill.description: Generate SVG artwork from a user prompt through Gemini image generation and autotrace conversion.
skill.summary: Converts image prompts into SVG files using Gemini and autotrace.
skill.author: 0x6a77

security_audit.summary: The skill contains real shell setup and generation workflows, including sudo installation, cloning autotrace, and a curl request to Gemini. Several markdown backtick detections are false positives, but the command blocks, network calls, and GEMINI_API_KEY handling are confirmed risks. No evidence found of a prompt injection attempt in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Privileged installation commands are embedded in the skill.
remediation.suggestion: Remove sudo steps from the skill and require users to install autotrace through trusted documentation or a vetted package.

remediation.issue: The setup clones and installs code from a mutable GitHub source.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a signed release or package version, and verify checksums before any build or installation step.

remediation.issue: The generation workflow passes a Gemini API key through a shell command.
remediation.suggestion: Use a secret manager or dedicated tool API that avoids exposing keys in shell history, logs, or process lists.

remediation.issue: User prompt and filename values are inserted into a shell pipeline.
remediation.suggestion: Escape prompt content, validate filenames, restrict output paths, and avoid direct shell interpolation for user-controlled values.

remediation.issue: Prompts are sent to an external image generation service.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose that prompt content leaves the local environment and request confirmation before sending sensitive material.

content.user_title: Create SVG Art From Image Prompts
content.value_statement: Producing SVG artwork from plain language can require image generation and tracing tools. This skill defines a Gemini and autotrace workflow to convert prompts into SVG files.
actual_capabilities: Guides setup for autotrace when it is missing.
Calls Gemini 2.5 Flash Image through a curl request.
Uses the user prompt as the image generation prompt with minimal edits.
Decodes returned image data and pipes it into autotrace.
Writes a generated SVG file with a prompt-based filename.
limitations: Requires a valid GEMINI_API_KEY and network access to Google APIs.
Requires autotrace and related native dependencies on the host.
Does not validate prompts, filenames, API responses, or SVG output.
Can expose prompts to an external image generation service.

use_cases.description: Create rough SVG illustrations for layout exploration before a designer refines the final asset.

use_cases.title: Generate Placeholder SVG Assets
use_cases.description: Produce temporary vector images for prototypes, demos, and documentation while final artwork is pending.

use_cases.title: Create Simple Diagram Seeds
use_cases.description: Turn a visual idea into an editable SVG starting point for lessons, slides, or guides.

output_examples.output: An SVG file named red-bicycle.svg containing a traced vector bicycle illustration.

output_examples.input: Create an SVG of a coffee cup icon for a settings page.
output_examples.output: An SVG file with a simple cup shape, neutral colors, and editable vector paths.

output_examples.input: Create an SVG of a small city skyline at sunset.
output_examples.output: An SVG illustration with skyline shapes, warm sky colors, and simplified building outlines.

best_practices: Review the generated SVG before using it in public products.
Use prompts that specify simple shapes, colors, and composition.
Run external setup commands only in a disposable or trusted environment.
anti_patterns: Do not include secrets, personal data, or private project details in prompts.
Do not run the setup commands on production systems without review.
Do not expect precise logos, text rendering, or brand-safe output.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates SVG files from image or scene prompts using Gemini image generation and autotrace conversion.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow expects a GEMINI_API_KEY value for the Google Gemini API request.

faq.question: Does prompt content leave my machine?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow sends prompt content to the Google Gemini API endpoint.

faq.question: Can it create production-ready SVG assets?
faq.answer: It can create useful drafts, but generated SVG files should be reviewed and cleaned before production use.

faq.question: What tools must be installed?
faq.answer: The workflow requires curl, base64 decoding tools, autotrace, and native dependencies needed by autotrace.

faq.question: Is it safe to run on a shared system?
faq.answer: Use caution. The setup uses sudo commands and installs software, so review it before running on shared systems.
